title: Father stabbed to death by his own son inside Long Island apartment on Labor Day: police
text:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

A Long Island dad was stabbed repeatedly in the gut by his adult son — but managed to crawl to a phone as he was dying to call police, officials said.

Sage Arias-Brown, 33, allegedly broke into his father, 69-year-old Edward Brown’s Mastic apartment at around 12:30 a.m. on Monday — then stabbed him multiple times in the abdomen and chest before fleeing, according to Suffolk County prosecutors.

“A witness heard [Arias-Brown] gain entry into the apartment and heard [Brown] screaming for help — the witness then saw him exit the building,” Assistant District Attorney Melissa Grier told the court as the scowling accused killer, who arrived at court in a worn track suit, fidgeted throughout the arraignment.

After being stabbed multiple times, Brown somehow mustered up the strength to make it to the phone and call 911 to report the brutal attack before collapsing as he waited for help to arrive, Grier detailed.

Brown was declared dead at the scene, prosecutors said.

Details of what exactly unfolded inside the apartment and whether there was any confrontation that led to the violence remains unclear.

Arias-Brown — who his attorney, Katherine Fernandez said has a history of mental illness and an open robbery case — was arrested just blocks away from his father’s apartment a short time after the killing, according to police.

He pleaded not guilty to second-degree murder and was remanded without bail on Tuesday and is due back in court on Friday.
